name: Operator app control comparison

tasks.name: add
tasks.goal: Calculate 7 + 8 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 15.

tasks.name: subtract
tasks.goal: Calculate 48 − 19 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 29.

tasks.name: multiply
tasks.goal: Calculate 6 × 7 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 42.

tasks.name: divide
tasks.goal: Calculate 81 ÷ 9 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 9.

tasks.name: decimal
tasks.goal: Calculate 1.5 + 2.25 in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 3.75.

tasks.name: percent
tasks.goal: Calculate 50 × 10% in Calculator and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 5.

tasks.name: chain
tasks.goal: Calculate 12 plus 8, press Equals, then multiply that result by 3 and press Equals. Finish with the displayed result 60.

tasks.name: clock-stopwatch
tasks.goal: Switch Clock from World Clock to Stopwatch. Only change tabs; do not start, stop, reset, add or edit anything.

tasks.name: clock-world-clock
tasks.goal: Switch Clock from Stopwatch to World Clock. Only change tabs; do not add, remove or edit anything.

tasks.name: settings-general
tasks.goal: Open General in Settings. Do not change any setting.

modes: plain Apple iPhone Mirroring through CUA
required_record: exact source revision and file hashes
correct completion, handback and uncertain input counts
native gesture phases and JEV model/calls/tokens
audio volume before and after control
interpretation: This compares automated control paths. It does not establish human speed. A failed or handed-back task contributes a failure, never a fast completion.
